content: Context-passing strategies at handoff: (1) full transcript forwarding - simple but costs scale with thread length/hops, risk of 'lost in the middle'; (2) structured context object (typed fields: id, intent, entities, status) - most token efficient (200-500 tokens vs 5-20k), recommended default; (3) LLM-summarized context - 70-90% token reduction but lossy and adds latency per hop, errors compound over multiple hops. Recommendation: structured briefing object + reference/link to full transcript rather than embedding it, avoid >4 sequential handoff hops.
